# Gujarat Bhavan Rameswaram

> Gujarat Bhavan (also called Gujarat Bhavan Dharmshala / Gujarati Bhavan, Rameshwaram) is a Gujarati dharamshala and pilgrim guest house at 15/16, Sannadhi Street, Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu 623526, India, a short walk from Sri Ramanathaswamy Temple. It is managed by Shri Dakshin Bharatiya Gujarati Seva Trust and offers AC and non-AC rooms plus an in-house Bhojanalaya serving pure vegetarian Gujarati food without onion and garlic.

Official website: https://www.gujaratbhavandharmshala.in/

## Key facts

- Name: Gujarat Bhavan Rameswaram (ગુજરાત ભવન રામેશ્વરમ / गुजरात भवन रामेश्वरम)
- Type: Gujarati dharamshala / pilgrim accommodation with Bhojanalaya (vegetarian dining hall)
- Managed by: Shri Dakshin Bharatiya Gujarati Seva Trust
- Address: 15/16, Sannadhi Street, Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu 623526, India
- Coordinates: 9.28821, 79.31970 (Plus Code 78Q9+7VP Rameswaram)
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/mpGKnk4Ngvu2DnGs6
- Location: Ramanathaswamy Temple area; short walk to the temple and Agni Theertham; about 2 km from Rameswaram railway station and bus stand; nearest airport is Madurai
- Rooms: AC and non-AC family rooms, double rooms, multi-bed rooms and shared group rooms for couples, families and yatra (pilgrim) groups
- Room booking: call or WhatsApp +91 73403 63525, or landline 04573 221 301. Bookings are confirmed directly by reception. Tariffs vary by room type and season; call for current rates.
- Email: gujaratbhawan869@gmail.com

## Bhojanalaya (Gujarati vegetarian food)

- Pure vegetarian Gujarati meals, no onion and no garlic, for staying guests and visitors
- Breakfast: 8:00–10:00 AM (daily selection varies)
- Lunch: 12:00–2:30 PM — roti, sabji, dal, rice, papad, buttermilk
- Dinner: 7:00–9:00 PM — roti, sabji, kadhi, khichdi, papad, buttermilk
- Drinks: hot/cold badam milk ₹75, sweet lassi ₹60, dry fruit lassi ₹75, rose milk ₹60, thondai milk ₹60
- Bhojanalaya phone: 04573 221 159 (please confirm timings before visiting)

## Nearby places

- Sri Ramanathaswamy Temple (Jyotirlinga and Char Dham site)
- Agni Theertham (sacred seashore beside the temple)
- Dhanushkodi
- Pamban Bridge
